findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 1, For the People Act of 2021
findings.note: Roll call 62. Neal voted Yea on House passage of a broad elections bill. The bill's voter ID provisions were not read for this entry, so it is saved only as a general election-law vote.

findings.passage: “There is just been this trend to make voting rights a partisan issue,”
findings.note: Quoted in a news story (reposted on his official site; the outlet name was not shown in the page text read) at a rally marking the 55th anniversary of the Voting Rights Act. He spoke about voting rights and Voting Rights Act re-authorization in general. The story's sentence about state voter ID requirements is the reporter's, not Neal's words, and is not saved.

findings.motion: On Passage, S. 1383 (Roll no. 69, 218 yeas to 213 nays; passed). The Clerk lists the Senate bill's title; the Washington Examiner reports the 218-213 House vote that evening as passage of the SAVE America Act, and Heritage Action describes the SAVE America Act as House amendment text to S.1383.
findings.note: Neal is recorded as Nay. Per Heritage Action, the SAVE America Act text would require documentary proof of citizenship to register, photo ID to cast a ballot in federal elections, and a process to remove non-citizens from voter rolls.
